audience: Shopify merchants who sell subscriptions with Stay AI

useCases.title: Find failed billing attempts and dunning state
useCases.text: List the billing attempts with their error codes and messages. Open the subscription of a customer to read its status and dunning state.

useCases.title: Review cancelled subscriptions
useCases.text: List the subscriptions with the cancelled status and open one to read its details.

useCases.title: Check the catalog and selling plans
useCases.text: List the catalog products that Stay can sell on subscription and open one. Read the selling plan groups that a shopper can pick, for one product or variant.

useCases.title: Look up subscription customers and recurring orders
useCases.text: List the subscription customers and the recurring orders, filtered by creation or update time.

useCases.title: End a subscription or skip one delivery
useCases.text: Cancel a subscription with the reasons the merchant or customer gave. Skip the next delivery of one line. Cancelling cannot be undone by this server, and a retried skip can skip a further delivery.
